## Current courses

::: cards
-   

    ### Introduction to Python *(Undergraduate)*

    -   Weekly labs; final mini-project aligned with UN SDGs.
    -   Topics: data types, control flow, functions, files, basic data analysis, plotting.
    -   **Materials:** [Class 1](./media/cours/25_26/python/py_seance_1.pdf){target="_blank"} ; [Class 2](./media/cours/25_26/python/py_seance_2.pdf){target="_blank"} ; [TP 1](./media/cours/25_26/python/TP_1.pdf){target="_blank"} ; [TP 1 - Correction](./media/cours/25_26/python/TP_1_corr.py){target="_blank"}

-   

    ### Duration Models *(Graduate)*

    -   Survival analysis: Kaplan--Meier, Cox, AFT, parametric & semi-parametric models.
    -   Hands-on in R/Stata with applied examples.
    -   **Materials:** *(To be added)*

-   

    ### Scientific Writing & Public Speaking *(Undergraduate)*
    -   Structure of papers, clarity, figures/tables, presentations, audience design.
    -   **Materials:** *(To be added)* [Class 1](./media/cours/25_26/cfm/Seance_1.pdf){target="_blank"} 



-   

    ### Public Economics *(Undergraduate)*

    -   Efficiency & equity, taxation, public goods, externalities, social insurance.
    -   **Materials:** *(PDF to be added)*

    ### Introduction to Macroeconomics *(Undergraduate)*

    -   Output, inflation, unemployment; simple models; policy debates.
